verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל־ דָּ֑ל בְּי֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’aš·rê maś·kîl ’el- dāl bə·yō·wm rā·‘āh yə·mal·lə·ṭê·hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David Blessed is the one who cares for the poor the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִֽ֭יחַיֵּהוּ יֶאְשֹּׁר בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְאַֽל־ תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗הוּ בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiš·mə·rê·hū wî·ḥay·yê·hū yɛʾš·šōr bā·’ā·reṣ wə·’al- tit·tə·nê·hū bə·ne·p̄eš ’ō·yə·ḇāw
verses.literal: The LORD will protect and preserve him He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־ עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כָּל־ מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְחָלְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yis·‘ā·ḏen·nū ‘al- ‘e·reś də·wāy kāl- miš·kā·ḇōw hā·p̄aḵ·tā ḇə·ḥā·lə·yōw
verses.literal: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed . . . of sickness

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נִי רְפָאָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י כִּי־ חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ănî- ’ā·mar·tî Yah·weh ḥān·nê·nî rə·p̄ā·’āh nap̄·šî kî- ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lāḵ
verses.literal: I said O LORD be gracious to me heal me for I have sinned against You

verses.original: אוֹיְבַ֗י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְאָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wy·ḇay yō·mə·rū ra‘ lî mā·ṯay yā·mūṯ wə·’ā·ḇaḏ šə·mōw
verses.literal: My enemies say with malice When will he die and be forgotten . . .

verses.original: וְאִם־ בָּ֤א לִרְא֨וֹת׀ שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗וֹ יִקְבָּץ־ אָ֥וֶן ל֑וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bā lir·’ō·wṯ šāw yə·ḏab·bêr lib·bōw yiq·bāṣ- ’ā·wen lōw yê·ṣê la·ḥūṣ yə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: My visitor . . . . . . speaks falsehood he gathers slander in his heart he goes out and spreads it abroad

verses.original: יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל־ שֹׂנְאָ֑י עָלַ֓י׀ יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥaḏ ‘ā·lay yiṯ·la·ḥă·šū kāl- śō·nə·’āy ‘ā·lay yaḥ·šə·ḇū rā·‘āh lî
verses.literal: All who hate me whisper . . . against me they imagine the worst for me

verses.original: דְּֽבַר־ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא־ יוֹסִ֥יף לָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- bə·lî·ya·‘al yā·ṣūq bōw wa·’ă·šer šā·k̲ab̲ lō- yō·w·sîp̄ lā·qūm
verses.literal: A vile disease has been poured into him he will never . . . get up from where he lies

verses.original: גַּם־ אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨י׀ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣י עָקֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’îš šə·lō·w·mî ’ă·šer- bā·ṭaḥ·tî ḇōw ’ō·w·ḵêl laḥ·mî hiḡ·dîl ‘ā·lay ‘ā·qêḇ
verses.literal: Even my close friend . . . whom I trusted the one who shared my bread has lifted up his heel against me

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה חָנֵּ֥נִי וַהֲקִימֵ֑נִי וַֽאֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh ḥān·nê·nî wa·hă·qî·mê·nî wa·’ă·šal·lə·māh lā·hem
verses.literal: But You O LORD be gracious to me and raise me up that I may repay them

verses.original: בְּזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי־ חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑י כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·zōṯ yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- ḥā·p̄aṣ·tā bî kî lō- yā·rî·a‘ ’ō·yə·ḇî ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: By this I know that You delight in me for my enemy does not triumph over me

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּ֭תֻמִּי תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑י וַתַּצִּיבֵ֖נִי לְפָנֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî bə·ṯum·mî tā·maḵ·tā bî wat·taṣ·ṣî·ḇê·nî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever

verses.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵֽ֭הָעוֹלָם וְעַ֥ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl mê·hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ hā·‘ō·w·lām ’ā·mên wə·’ā·mên
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD the God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting Amen and Amen
